title: Tough Egg
move_pattern: Starts with Hatch. After transformation, only uses Nibble attacks.
notes: The Tough Egg is a transforming monster that begins as an egg with 15-19 HP protected by HatchPower. On its first turn, the Hatch move triggers a transformation into a Hatchling form with 20-23 HP, and the move pattern switches to cycling Nibble attacks. The monster's title changes to 'Hatchling' after hatching. All non-Minion powers are removed during the transformation.
